strategies.name: Block-parallel factor broadcast reduction

Increases all-reduce count to ~15 (8 data + 7 factor syncs) but enables parallel factor computation and may improve pipeline efficiency with smaller factor payloads interleaved with data.

strategies.name: Pipelined reduce-scatter and all-gather
strategies.desc: Decompose each all-reduce into reduce-scatter + all-gather pairs to overlap computation of factors with gather phase. After reduce-scatter, each rank computes factors on its local shard, applies them, then all-gather collects results. ~16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG) but enables computation-communication overlap during the gather phase.

strategies.name: Batched all-reduce with stacked buffers
strategies.desc:
Stack multiple iteration buffers into a single contiguous tensor and issue batched/grouped all-reduce operations where hardware supports it, or use a single all-reduce on concatenated [iter1_buf, iter2_buf, ...] payload.
